info.name: BACKUP EAGLE REST API
info.description: Generated from the BACKUP EAGLE REST API manual (BACKUPEAGLE_MANUALS/manuals/en/source/rest_api). All endpoints require a BACKUP EAGLE user with the 'admin' role (some also allow additional roles as documented per resource) authenticated via HTTP Basic Auth. {{baseUrl}} defaults to https://localhost:10987/api/rest. The BACKUP EAGLE Server uses a self-signed certificate by default - disable SSL certificate verification in Postman settings (Settings > General > SSL certificate verification = OFF) for localhost testing. The REST API must be activated first via the BACKUP EAGLE Admin Client (Settings > Configuration > Server > REST > REST API active?).

item.name: Connection test
item.description: Verify that the BACKUP EAGLE REST API is reachable and that the supplied Basic Auth credentials are accepted, before using any other endpoint.

request.description: Check that the REST API endpoint is reachable and the provided Basic Auth credentials are accepted; no specific role is required.

item.name: Server/Devices
item.description: Manage backup servers and devices (data sources) of all supported types: query the current inventory, create and update server-specific configurations (Azure, BRMS, Cohesity, CommVault, Device, Generic, ISP, ISPP, NetWorker, PowerProtect, Rubrik, SEP sesam, Veeam, Veeam365, vCenter), change stored credentials, and run or poll connection tests.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all configured backup servers and devices (data sources). Available to the admin and analyst roles.
Update the stored password for one or more existing servers/devices, identified by type and server name.
Trigger an asynchronous connection test for the data source with the given id; poll the result endpoint to retrieve the outcome.
Retrieve the result of a previously triggered connection test using its process id.
Create a new Azure data source with the given name, tenant, and REST credentials.
Create a new IBM BRMS data source with the given share address and credentials.
Create a new Cohesity data source with the given domain, REST address, and credentials.
Create a new CommVault data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new device (e.g. DataDomain) with SNMP and SSH connection details.
Create a new generic data source that can be used as a target for manually uploaded or imported backup results.
Create a new IBM Spectrum Protect (ISP/TSM) server with its dsmadmc connection string and credentials.
Create a new IBM Spectrum Protect Plus (ISPP) data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new Dell NetWorker server with its address, generation, legato binary directory, and daemon log path.
Create a new Dell PowerProtect data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new Rubrik data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new SEP sesam data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new Veeam Backup & Replication data source with the given address and PowerShell binary path.
Create a new Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Create a new VMware vCenter data source with the given REST address and credentials.
Retrieve the result of the asynchronous initialization that runs after creating a new server/device, using its process id.
Update an existing Azure data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing BRMS data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing Cohesity data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing CommVault data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing device identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing generic data source identified by id, e.g. to change its timezone.
Update an existing ISP/TSM server identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing ISPP data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing NetWorker server identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing PowerProtect data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing Rubrik data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing SEP sesam data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing Veeam data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing Veeam365 data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Update an existing vCenter data source identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.

item.name: Projects/Schedules
item.description: Query configured backup projects/schedules (also available to the ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles) and activate or deactivate them (admin or ca_admin role) for specific domains, nodes, and servers.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all configured backup projects/schedules. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.
Activate one or more projects/schedules matching the given domain, node, server, and project name filters. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.
Deactivate one or more projects/schedules matching the given domain, node, server, and project name filters. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.

item.name: Nodes/Clients/VMs
item.description: Query backup clients/nodes/VMs, optionally including deactivated ones (also available to the ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles); activate, deactivate, or update the custom fields of nodes (admin or ca_admin role).

request.description: Retrieve the list of currently active nodes/clients/VMs. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.
Retrieve the list of all nodes/clients/VMs, including deactivated ones, via the all query parameter. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.
Activate one or more nodes/clients/VMs matching the given domain, node, and server filters. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.
Deactivate one or more nodes/clients/VMs matching the given domain, node, and server filters. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.
Set custom field values on nodes matching the given node name filter. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.
Set a custom field value across all nodes by clearing the custom filter, instead of restricting the change to a specific node. Requires the admin or ca_admin role.

item.name: Backup/Restore Results
item.description: Query backup and restore job results for a given time range, and drill down into the individual backed-up objects and their detail messages. Also available to the ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.

request.description: Retrieve backup/restore job results within the given start and end time range. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.
Retrieve the individual backed-up objects belonging to a specific backup/restore result, identified by baResultId. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.
Retrieve the detail messages logged for a specific backed-up object within a backup/restore result. Available to the admin, ca_admin, ca_access, and analyst roles.

item.name: Mail Management
item.description: Manage mail recipients, recipient groups, and newsgroups used for distributing BACKUP EAGLE reports and notifications by email.

request.description: Retrieve the list of configured mail recipients.
Create a new mail recipient with the given name and email address.
Update an existing mail recipient identified by id.
Permanently delete the mail recipient with the given id.
Retrieve the list of configured mail recipient groups.
Create a new recipient group containing the given list of mail recipient ids.
Update an existing recipient group identified by id, e.g. its name or member recipient ids.
Permanently delete the recipient group with the given id.
Retrieve the list of all configured newsgroups.
Retrieve a single newsgroup by its id.
Create a new newsgroup that mails matching reports (selected by file name pattern) to the given recipients and/or recipient groups within an active time window.

{
    "name": "All PDFs",
    "pattern": "*.pdf",
    "subject": "BACKUP EAGLE Reports",
    "text": "BACKUP EAGLE Reports",
    "activeFrom": "08:00",
    "activeTo": "18:00",
    "mergeMails": true,
    "recipientIds": [
        12
    ],
    "recipientGroupIds": [
        1
    ]
}

request.description: Update an existing newsgroup identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Permanently delete the newsgroup with the given id.

item.name: User Defined Group Management
item.description: Create, update, delete, and list user-defined groups (UDGs) that combine servers and nodes by filter criteria for grouping and reporting.

request.description: Retrieve the list of configured user-defined groups.
Create a new user-defined group with the given name, address list, and filter elements matching servers/nodes.
Update an existing user-defined group identified by id.
Permanently delete the user-defined group with the given id.

item.name: Report Management
item.description: Query configured reports, execute them on demand for a given time range and export format, copy a report to a user-defined group, and delete reports. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.

request.description: Retrieve the list of configured reports. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.
Copy an existing report to a target user-defined group, optionally enabling scheduled mailing for the copy. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.
Execute a report on demand for the given time range and export format (e.g. PDF) and return the generated file. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.
Permanently delete the report with the given id. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.
Execute a report on demand using an extended export format (e.g. CSV) for the given time range. Available to the admin and report_admin roles.

item.name: XML/log file/CSV upload
item.description: Upload XML, log, or CSV files generically into BACKUP EAGLE for collector processing, optionally assigning them to a specific data source and subdirectory. Unlike most other endpoints, no specific role is required beyond a valid BACKUP EAGLE login.

request.description: Upload an XML, log, or CSV file for generic collector processing, optionally specifying the target data source name and a subdirectory as (disabled by default) form fields. No specific role is required beyond a valid BACKUP EAGLE login.

item.name: Server- and Device Group Management
item.description: Manage server groups and device groups used to bundle backup servers or devices by pattern-based criteria such as type and version.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all server groups.
Retrieve a single server group by its id.
Create a new server group with entries matching servers by pattern criteria such as server type.
Update an existing server group identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Permanently delete the server group with the given id.
Retrieve the list of all device groups.
Retrieve a single device group by its id.
Create a new device group with entries matching devices by pattern criteria such as device type.
Update an existing device group identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged.
Permanently delete the device group with the given id.

item.name: User Management
item.description: Manage BACKUP EAGLE users, roles, and user groups, including role assignment, group membership, and password changes.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all configured users.
Retrieve a single user by its id.
Update an existing user identified by id, e.g. to change its assigned role ids.
Retrieve the list of all configured roles.
Retrieve a single role by its id.
Assign a role to a user-defined group by creating a new role entry linking a role id and a user-defined group id.
Permanently delete the role with the given id.
Retrieve the list of all user groups.
Retrieve a single user group by its id.
Create a new user group with the given name, description, and directory alias (e.g. for LDAP/AD mapping).
Update an existing user group identified by id, e.g. its role assignments.
Permanently delete the user group with the given id.
Set a new password for the user with the given id.

item.name: RMAN Catalog Management
item.description: Manage Oracle RMAN catalog configurations: list, create, update, test connectivity, activate/deactivate, and delete them.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all configured Oracle RMAN catalog connections.

item.name: Query RMAN Catalog Config with id

request.description: Retrieve a single RMAN catalog configuration by its id.

item.name: Connection Test RMAN Catalog with id

request.description: Test the database connection for the RMAN catalog configuration with the given id.
Create a new Oracle RMAN catalog configuration with the given JDBC connection string and credentials.
Update an existing RMAN catalog configuration identified by id.
Activate or deactivate the RMAN catalog configuration with the given id via the active query parameter.
Permanently delete the RMAN catalog configuration with the given id.

item.name: Maintenance Windows
item.description: List, add, and delete maintenance windows that suppress alerting for servers, devices, or nodes during planned downtime. Available to the admin role, or to the matching ca_admin_maintmode_mgr* role for the affected maintenance window type (node, server, or device).

request.description: Retrieve maintenance windows; the all query parameter includes past/expired windows in addition to current and upcoming ones. Available to the admin role or the matching ca_admin_maintmode_mgr* role for the maintenance window type.

Create a new maintenance window for a server, device, or node covering the given start and end time. Available to the admin role or the matching ca_admin_maintmode_mgr* role for the maintenance window type.
Permanently delete the maintenance window with the given id and type. Available to the admin role or the matching ca_admin_maintmode_mgr* role for the maintenance window type.

item.name: Server/Device classes
item.description: Query the list of server and device classes (types) supported by BACKUP EAGLE.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all server and device classes (types) supported by BACKUP EAGLE.

item.name: License Management
item.description: Upload new license files (replacing the entire current license set) and query the currently installed licenses.

request.description: Upload a new license file; this replaces the entire current set of installed licenses rather than merging with it.
Retrieve the list of currently installed licenses.

item.name: Tenant Management
item.description: Manage multi-tenant configuration: import tenant configuration files, update the remote host used for tenant communication, and query tenants and their connection status.

request.description: Import a tenant configuration file to set up or update a tenant.
Update the remote host and port used for tenant communication.
Retrieve the list of all configured tenants.
Retrieve a single tenant by its id.
Test the connection to the tenant with the given id.

item.name: Credentials Management
item.description: Manage centrally stored credentials (e.g. username/password) that can be referenced by servers, devices, and other configurations: list, create, update, and delete them.

request.description: Retrieve the list of all stored credentials; secret fields such as password or token are never included in the response.
Create a new credentials entry with the given name, type (e.g. USER_PASSWORD), user, and secret; the id is always generated by the server and a new entry can never be created as built-in.
Update an existing credentials entry identified by id; fields omitted from the request body are left unchanged, including the secret if not provided, and the credentials type cannot be changed.
Permanently delete the credentials entry with the given id; credentials marked as built-in (delivered with the application, e.g. "ISP Planfile Server Query") cannot be deleted.
